statement: A change that only narrows, every operation one of: removing a binding of an ALLOW-only policy, making an attachable ALLOW-only policy unattachable, a new DENY-only policy or a new binding of one, none on a policy id the platform also defines, staged by a holder of cosec:skip-shadow, takes a busy staging slot: the holder is made CONFLICTED first, from whichever staged state it is in, and keeps its slot when it cannot be. A READY holder whose revision the chain shows written is settled PUBLISHED by whichever change comes for its slot. A PUBLISHED change that still holds its slot, because releasing it after the head write failed, is settled by publishing it again: the slot is released and the publish recorded once, by the call that released it, and no revision is written (#1386). A publish goes on only while its change holds the slot, checked again right before its head write; the change that took a slot and finds the head its holder wrote over the same base records why it failed. Any other change waits (409).
guards: control:ChangesB2Test#only a whitelist of changes narrows
control:ChangesB2Test#an emergency deny takes a busy slot, a widening change does not
control:ChangesB2Test#an operation on a policy id the platform also defines does not narrow
control:ChangesB2Test#a holder that cannot be marked conflicted keeps its slot
control:PreemptionRaceTest#a holder approved while it is preempted is conflicted
control:PreemptionRaceTest#a holder whose window closes while it is preempted is conflicted
control:PreemptionRaceTest#a change preempted while it publishes publishes nothing
control:RetriedPublishTest#a retry after a lost reply finishes the publish as its publisher
control:PreemptionRaceTest#a change preempted before its head write writes nothing
control:PreemptionRaceTest#the change that took a slot records the publish that beat it
control:PreemptionRaceTest#a preemption that gives up says so
control:RetriedPublishTest#a revoke settles a published holder and takes its slot
control:RetriedPublishTest#a publish and its retry record it once
control:RetriedPublishTest#a publish whose slot release failed is settled by publishing it again, adding no revision
control:RetriedPublishTest#two retries that both saw the slot held settle it once
control:PreemptionRaceTest#a head write that meets the preempting change's head records the failure
